# Prometheus rules: alerts for your services.
# Generated by Raion. Do not edit: changes are overwritten on the next "raion apply".
# To change it, edit your workspace files and run "raion plan".
groups:
  - name: raion-service-ledger-api
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - alert: ServiceHighErrorRate
        expr: ((sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="ledger-api",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="ledger-api"}[5m]))) > 0.05 and sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="ledger-api"}[5m])) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service_name: ledger-api
          team: payments
          raion_scope: service
        annotations:
          summary: "ledger-api: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of requests are failing"
          description: More than 5% of requests to ledger-api have failed with a server error (HTTP 5xx) for 5m. Open the service dashboard to see which routes fail, then the error logs and failed traces.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-svc-ledger-api
          raion_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/services/ledger-api
      - alert: ServiceHighLatency
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="ledger-api"}[5m]))) > 1 and sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="ledger-api"}[5m])) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service_name: ledger-api
          team: payments
          raion_scope: service
        annotations:
          summary: "ledger-api: 95% of requests take up to {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}"
          description: The 95th-percentile response time of ledger-api has been above 1000 ms for 5m. Check "p95 latency by route" and the slow-request traces on the service dashboard.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-svc-ledger-api
          raion_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/services/ledger-api
      - alert: ServiceTelemetryMissing
        expr: (sum(count_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="ledger-api"}[6h])) > 0) unless (sum(count_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="ledger-api"}[10m])) > 0)
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service_name: ledger-api
          team: payments
          raion_scope: service
        annotations:
          summary: ledger-api stopped sending telemetry
          description: No request metrics have arrived from ledger-api for 15 minutes, although it was sending them earlier. Either the service is down, or it can no longer reach the collector. Check the service, then "raion verify --service".
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-svc-ledger-api
          raion_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/services/ledger-api
  - name: raion-service-payment-api

      - alert: ServiceHighErrorRate

          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-svc-payment-api
          raion_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/services/payment-api
